nomor yang memberikan kata sandi itu apa aja beritahu saya

File `allowed_contacts.json` nggak ketemu di path itu. Mungkin nama file-nya beda atau lokasinya beda. Gue cek struktur folder bot-nya dulu ya.

<tool_call>
<function=jalankan_terminal>
<parameter=perintah>
ls -la /workspaces/tab-html/wa-antigravity-bot/ 2>/dev/null | head -50
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
udah selesai kamu cek belum

<tool_call>
<function=jalankan_terminal>
<parameter=perintah>
find /workspaces/tab-html/wa-antigravity-bot -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name "*.json" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.ts" \) 2>/dev/null | head -40
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
oke jalankan

Tool `jalankan_terminal` ternyata lagi nge-route ke **PowerShell Windows** (laptop HP kamu), bukan ke Linux VPS. Jadi `2>/dev/null` malah error karena PowerShell nggak ngerti syntax bash.

Gue sesuaikan perintahnya biar jalan di PowerShell:

<tool_call>
<function=jalankan_terminal>
<parameter=perintah>
Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\Users\HP" -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*allowed*" -or $_.Name -like "*contact*" -or $_.Name -like "*whitelist*" } | Select-Object -First 20 FullName
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
oke jalankan

<tool_call>
<function=jalankan_terminal>
<parameter=perintah>
Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\Users\HP" -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in @('.json','.js','.ts') -and $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' } | Select-Object -First 20 FullName
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
Dah terminal di mana

<tool_call>
<function=jalankan_terminal>
<parameter=perintah>
ls -la /home/codespace/ && echo "---" && ls -la /workspaces/ 2>/dev/null || echo "workspaces tidak ada"
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
Jadi hasilnya

<tool_call>
<function=jalankan_terminal>
<parameter=perintah>
Get-Location; Write-Host "---"; Get-ChildItem
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
